name: latelier
description: Plateforme personnelle de Nathan SENG : un Worker Cloudflare, des modules indépendants. Premier module — le CV.

scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build:cv && npm run build:shell && npm run compose:remotes
scripts.dev: npm run build:contract && concurrently -n api,cv,shell -c cyan,green,magenta "tsx watch apps/api/src/dev-node.ts" "npm run start --workspace @latelier/cv-app" "npm run start --workspace @latelier/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contract && tsx watch apps/api/src/dev-node.ts
scripts.dev:cv: npm run build:contract && npm run start --workspace @latelier/cv-app
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contract && npm run start --workspace @latelier/web
